annotations.text:
A · WARKAH — the record.
The answer sits above the fold; the photograph works inside the grid at column width.
Strength: our one real advantage (six of fourteen jurisdictions set no minimum) is visible in the first screen.
Cost: the least emotional of the three.

B · DULANG — the object.
The photograph is the page. Full bleed, headline on its own parchment ground, never over the picture.
Strength: every measured competitor is photographically empty; this is the direction that spends the restraint.
Cost: the LCP budget, and it breaks when a cover is missing (see Ujian 2).

C · MARGIN — the annotated reference.
A 68ch column with a permanent 268px rail carrying the record's meta; the table is the one moment the spread opens.
Strength: handles a long Malay title best, and gives the meta a permanent home.
Cost: the rail is a desktop idea and 64% of impressions are mobile.
Dark is drawn beside light, not translated from it. The 2026-07-14 decision stands: dark stays unreachable to a reader. Four palette values on each screen, plus photography.
The four cases a static mock always omits, drawn in all three directions: a 95-character Malay title, a missing cover, an empty category, and a three-line title beside a one-line title.
